1. An acousto-optic imaging system comprising:

at least one optical sensor configured to produce one or more optical responses upon receiving harmonic or subharmonic ultrasound echoes corresponding to the transmitted ultrasound signal, wherein the at least one optical sensor has a bandwidth ranging from at least f/M to Nf where M and N are integers greater than 1.
